title: Cursor/pr6621 paid merge gate e215
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Audit of open PR #6621 (`e772ff8f300f4687bd8fa059f9e8f98719de121c`), card `supplier-boundary-audit`. No new κ and no selected-frontier change. The selected record remains κ = 0.00310045.

The public `complete_cost` histograms of #6621 and #6551 (`11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674`) differ by exactly 18 times the stated per-call edit

```text
paid    {1:-3, 3:-1, 4:+1, 5:-1, 6:+1}
targets {8:+1, 9:-1}
```

Productive fields stay 13,756, paid calls fall from 67,096 to 67,042, and the rank-mass surplus stays 760. For `H(r) = r^t` with `0 < t < 1`, the multisets `{1,1,1,3,5,8}` and `{4,6,9}` have equal sum 19 and the first is strictly majorized by the second, so the signed gain of that count delta is positive.

The top-level `invoice.compare` gate does not certify that merge. It differences the candidate against `research/gaussian-root-retirement/RESULT.json` inside #6621's `source.tar`. That file still prints status `PASS_GAUSSIAN_ROOT_RETIREMENT_KAPPA_00329394` and kappa `164697/50000000`, but its histograms already contain the native merge relative to the unmodified receipt in #6551's `source.tar` (sha256 `13639e4770964ded237b79d72ad517448de269b34d724beaa70757dbe0be6fe2`). The gate therefore still reports only `208*(H41-H40-H57+H56)`. The rewritten raw-root lower endpoint `164801644010225711532641/50000000000000000000000000` lies strictly above the unmodified upper endpoint and strictly above the kappa string the file still prints.

The native-word census is independent of the replay: program length 18,493 to 18,561 (`ADD +69`, `MOVE -3`, `INIT +1`, `CLEAR +1`), and the only `final` change is index 435 from frame 127 to 246. `BASEWORD.json.gz` in the #6621 archive is byte-identical to the #6551 native `WORD.json.gz`.

Remaining obligation: the Gaussian rank assignment still depends on the nested replay, which this package does not run. The ordinary-work expression at 611 caller events stays 254,932,208 because that formula does not read the native program length.

## Task and overlap

Base: CrocSwap `main` `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Task `supplier-boundary-audit`, scope refined to this one candidate and this one gate. Overlap search on 2026-11-03 (572 open PRs, discussion snapshot complete) hits #6621 itself and the distinct cross-side paid-job threshold in #5298. PR #6554 audits the #6551 retirement cut and does not inspect this native merge.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/pr6621-paid-merge-gate/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr6621-paid-merge-gate
```

Marker `PASS_PR6621_MERGE_GATE_DOES_NOT_SEE_THE_MERGE`. Also `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. CPython 3.12, standard library. Four mutated failure controls are inside the verifier. The native column replay and both rational moment engines were not run.

## Credit

Construction and conditional κ claim: DreamingOfClouds, PR #6621, on Ali Romman's PR #6551 and the retained PR #6545 / PR #6529 lineage. Open retirement audit: DLamdata, PR #6554. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Replace the archived Gaussian-retirement receipt with the unmodified #6551 copy and rerun the published verifier; the first assertion to read is `invoice.compare`. Separately, assign Gaussian ranks to the two vendored words without the edited native verifier. Both are blocked here by the replay this session did not execute.
